title: AHB Grant and Ownership Handover
description: Inspect the stalled handover: HGRANT_DMA can identify the next owner, but DMA cannot own the address phase until a rising edge where HREADY is HIGH.

annotations.message: CPU owns the shared address phase because HGRANT_CPU and HREADY were both HIGH at the accepting edge.
DMA requests the bus while CPU continues its burst. A request alone never changes the active owner.
The arbiter names DMA as the next owner, but HREADY is LOW. CPU remains HMASTER and must hold its active address/control stable.
HREADY returns HIGH. CPU's stalled transfer completes and the DMA grant is accepted at this boundary.
DMA now owns the address phase and starts its independent transfer with HTRANS=NONSEQ.
DMA continues with SEQ. Verification must also delay write-data ownership by one accepted address phase.
